changes: Separate empty material reference from loaded initial positions; natural edge lengths and hinge angles are not overwritten by contents.
Use the same empty two-panel topology for configurable independent box, sphere, cylinder and convex OBJ contents.
Share vertex bodies across membrane, layer/self-contact surfaces and small rigid-contact patches without duplicating membrane elasticity.
Retain nonlinear SLS hinge forces and accepted-step material history updates; guard one active bag model per process.
bag.sha256_scope: Historical upstream source files before local modifications.

units: SI (metres, kilograms, seconds); CLI thickness/radius in mm

scene_adaptations: 180 x 240 mm empty two-panel bag, 14 x 18 cells per panel, three connected edges and one open mouth.
140 g configured bag mass, 2 mm equivalent wall and 1 mm contact radius; uncalibrated material parameters.
Contents are separate free rigid bodies. Loaded coordinates are prepared by distance/contact projections, followed by dynamics.
84 rigid-contact patches plus two full layer/self-contact surfaces share the 570 original material vertices.
material_profile.thickness_source: User estimate of 2 mm per wall; not independently measured.

contents.mesh_collision: MuJoCo convex hull; initialization uses the mesh bounding box.
contents.reference: Empty two-panel material reference, shared across contents.
contents.initialization: 1600 distance/contact projection iterations for loaded cases; no changes to natural reference geometry.
contents.dynamics: Independent free rigid bodies, gravity, membrane and hinge forces, frictional contacts; no attachment.
contents.visibility: Transparent and opaque previews use the same saved settled state.

appearance.type: synthetic film albedo with baked wrinkle shading
appearance.mapping: per-vertex UVs on both deformable panels; shared by MuJoCo and OBJ/MTL

known_limits: Frequent solver iteration-limit frames remain for the flat empty bag.
Reported maximum penetration is sampled every 10 ms, not every internal timestep.
No sealed air, thickness compression, tearing or seam failure model.
Material values other than the user-provided wall estimate remain configuration values.

sealed_conveyor_contact_sort_scene.mode: closed gripper contact push; no lift grasp
